summary: DeepSeek launched DeepSeek-V4-Pro to general availability with agent-focused upgrades, flexible reasoning effort levels, and a new peak/off-peak API pricing scheme.

mechanisms.reason: The release highlights major upgrades to agent capabilities intended for production agent workflows.
mechanisms.quote: Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains!

mechanisms.reason: The new off-peak pricing tier cuts the cost of serving tokens by half during non-peak periods.
mechanisms.quote: Off-peak rates are 50% lower than peak, enabling more flexible workload scheduling.
